name: Verified announcement demand continuation
hypothesis: Buy after a timestamped primary announcement and a completed price breakout confirmed by independent on-chain purchases.
spec: Setup: A public announcement may attract sustained demand beyond its first reaction. Entry: Buy after a timestamped primary announcement and a completed price breakout confirmed by independent on-chain purchases. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on announcement correction, flow reversal, or the event time limit. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs a social / announcement feed with receipt times (not connected)
